# tarsus

> Safe hands for tool-calling agents: batch tool execution with payload repair, a deterministic safety guard, kernel (Landlock) write confinement, human-only approval, audit trail and an MCP server. Linux only.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus && cd tarsus && python3 bin/omnitool_guard.py selftest` (expect: OMNITOOL-GUARD SELFTEST: PASS (62/62)).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (free trial for evaluation).
